note: Closed Creator Desk aggregate themes. The order follows 12-month department category totals (aggregates only, not root causes and not forum frequencies), then the product axes that ranking does not already name. A forum case clusters from its existing category and read theme. Fields, forms, reports, Deluge language, integrations, limits, and billing stay unmapped.
method: Match a listed read theme first, then a listed category, then a symptom phrase. The primary theme is the most specific match. Ties break by priority (lower number first). No match leaves the primary as none. Symptom phrases are whole words and are used only for Actions, which has no forum category.
